switches.NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS: appended to whatever store is active; unchanged from the earlier port
switches.NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA=1: bundled Node 24 roots plus OpenSSL's default verify paths
switches.NODE_OPTIONS=--use-openssl-ca: OpenSSL's default verify paths replace the bundled roots
switches.SSL_CERT_FILE: selects the CA file for a system/OpenSSL store; ignored by the bundled store
switches.SSL_CERT_DIR: selects the hashed CA directory for a system/OpenSSL store; ignored by the bundled store

trustStore.qualification: Only the exact value 1 enables NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA: 0, false, true, empty and any other value leave the bundled store, matching the reference process. System roots are read once per process from OpenSSL's default verify paths (SSL_CERT_FILE/SSL_CERT_DIR when set, else the platform defaults) with the same tolerance for unreadable or non-certificate directory entries. Duplicate certificates between the file and the directory do not change any trust decision, so only decisions are compared.

diagnostics.method: rustls reports UnknownIssuer for both a self-signed leaf and a leaf issued by an unknown CA, so the handshake captures the presented leaf and compares its DER issuer and subject: equal issuer/subject is the self-signed reason, otherwise the unknown-issuer reason. No other error text is changed.

implementation: src/vault/slot.rs: enter() writes the byte-preserving stash (backup) then the non-secret placeholder (marker) before custody; exit() chooses restored/conflict/nothing-to-do; the Hook is the fault-injection seam.
src/vault/source.rs: synchronize() wraps the transition: read mode, enter on custody, exit on local and refuse SLOT_CONFLICT on conflict, re-read the mode and refuse CHANGED if it moved.
src/native/vault.rs: transaction() exposes enter/exit through the host credential-store port for custody/local mode changes.
